summary: First successful MAGELLAN run (10k episodes, seed=0, buffer=100k, 32 envs). Grasp reached 100% at step 5005 (slower than later runs). All grow_* goals stayed at 0%. Entropy NaN present throughout — the entropy bug was active, corrupting alpha tuning and LP signal. All estimated_lp values ended at 0.0 despite brief nonzero readings mid-run, suggesting the NaN entropy interfered with SR head training.

findings.description: Entropy is NaN at end of run (has_nan=true). Padded action log-probs are unmasked in updater.py, causing NaN to propagate into the entropy estimate and alpha gradient.
findings.recommendation: Fixed in 86722adf. Check updater.py mask logic.

findings.description: Reached 100% at step 5005. Slower than later runs (4003 in 706d17e9, 4002 in b5452f4a) — entropy NaN may have disrupted early learning.
All LP estimates ended at 0.0 (only 4 nonzero readings mid-run). LP signal is not persisting — likely corrupted by entropy NaN affecting SR head gradients.
findings.recommendation: Verify after entropy fix. In 86722adf (entropy fixed), LP is similarly 0 at end — deeper issue with LP threshold or SR head.

findings.description: 0% at end. Expected — grow_plants requires chain actions and 10k episodes is insufficient even without bugs.

comparison: First run with metrics after two startup crashes. Established baseline: grasp is learnable, but entropy NaN bug is present and LP signal is not working.
